name: wpgrock Chat Button
author: wpgrock

sections.description:
wpgrock WhatsApp Chat Button adds a customizable chat button that can open a WhatsApp conversation from your WordPress website. Configure the phone number and message from wpgrock Chat Button > Settings.

Features include:

  • Floating WhatsApp chat button.
  • Multiple WhatsApp button styles.
  • Custom message and dynamic variables.
  • Desktop and mobile visibility controls.
  • Homepage, page, post and WooCommerce product display rules.
  • Include or exclude content by ID.
  • WooCommerce product enquiry button.
  • Shortcode support.
  • Optional privacy-friendly click analytics stored locally.
  • Optional lead capture form before opening WhatsApp.
  • Lead fields for first name, last name, email, phone number and message.
  • Lead data stored locally in the site’s WordPress database.
  • Flexible serialized lead data structure for future fields.

Privacy

When lead capture is disabled, the plugin does not intentionally store visitor names, email addresses, phone numbers or chat message content.

When lead capture is enabled by the site administrator, the form data (first name, last name, email, phone number and message) is stored in the website’s own WordPress database. Basic source metadata such as page URL, page title, post ID, device type and creation time is stored with the lead. Site administrators are responsible for providing an appropriate privacy notice and handling stored lead data in accordance with applicable privacy laws and their site’s privacy policy.

When optional click analytics are enabled by the site administrator, the plugin stores the page path, related WordPress post ID when available, device type and click time in the website’s own WordPress database. Analytics are disabled by default.

After a lead is submitted, the visitor’s browser is sent to WhatsApp using a WhatsApp URL. The submitted lead details are included in the WhatsApp message. The use of WhatsApp is governed by the applicable WhatsApp and Meta policies.

This plugin does not send lead data or analytics data to the plugin author or to a third-party analytics service.

Disclaimer

This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WhatsApp or Meta. WhatsApp is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install it from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate wpgrock Chat Button.
  3. Go to wpgrock Chat Button > Settings.
  4. Enter your WhatsApp number with country code and without the plus sign.
  5. Save the settings.
  6. Optionally enable lead capture if you want visitors to submit their details before opening WhatsApp.
  7. Optionally enable click analytics if you want to store local click counts.
sections.faq:
Does this work with WhatsApp Business?

Yes. Enter the WhatsApp-enabled phone number with its country code.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes. When WooCommerce is active, you can enable a product enquiry button from the plugin settings.

Does the plugin store visitor IP addresses?

No. The plugin does not intentionally store visitor IP addresses. Optional click analytics are stored locally and do not intentionally store IP addresses or chat message content.

Are analytics enabled automatically?

No. Click analytics are disabled by default and can be enabled by the site administrator in the plugin settings.

Does the plugin store captured leads?

Only when Lead Capture is enabled. Captured lead fields are stored in the site’s own WordPress database and can be viewed from wpgrock Chat Button > Leads.

Can future lead fields be added without changing the lead table?

Yes. The flexible lead fields are stored together as a serialized data structure in one database column, so additional fields can be added in future versions without requiring a separate database column for each field.

What shortcode can I use?

The preferred shortcode is [wpgrock_chat_button]. The existing [smart_whatsapp] shortcode is also retained for backward compatibility.

How do I disable the floating button?

Go to wpgrock Chat Button > Settings and uncheck Enable chat widget.
sections.changelog:
2.0.1

  • Updated the lead capture popup to use a compact anchored layout near the chat button.
  • Removed the full-screen overlay behavior so the page remains visible behind the form.
  • Improved responsive sizing and spacing for the lead form.

2.0.0

  • Added optional lead capture before opening WhatsApp.
  • Added first name, last name, email, phone number and message fields.
  • Added flexible serialized lead storage for future fields.
  • Added a Leads admin screen with individual and bulk deletion.
  • Added lead form settings and privacy notice.
  • Preserved the existing chat button, WooCommerce, display-rule, shortcode and analytics functionality.

1.1.7

  • Updated the tested WordPress version metadata.
  • Corrected plugin text-domain metadata for automated directory checks.

1.1.6

  • Updated the plugin name and slug for directory naming and trademark compliance.
  • Added a distinct wpgrock-prefixed code namespace/prefix for plugin declarations, stored data, AJAX actions and assets.
  • Retained the existing [smart_whatsapp] shortcode for backward compatibility and added [wpgrock_chat_button].
  • Preserved existing frontend, WooCommerce, display-rule and analytics features.
